data.additional_information:
Work on research and integration of airborne perception systems including RGB cameras, thermal imagers, RADAR, LiDAR, optics, payload electronics, and real-time sensor processing pipelines for unmanned aerial platforms. 

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 

Research RGB, thermal, RADAR, LiDAR, and multi-sensor perception systems. 
Study MIPI CSI, USB, Ethernet, CAN, and sensor interface technologies. 
Analyze bandwidth, latency, and synchronization in perception payloads. 
Investigate thermal imaging, depth sensing, and mmWave RADAR technologies. 
Study sensor fusion using camera, IMU, LiDAR, and RADAR systems. 
Analyze ISP behavior, encoding, and real-time streaming pipelines. 
Support bring-up and debugging of cameras and perception sensors. 
Evaluate optics, focal length, and field-of-view tradeoffs. 
Analyze video quality, compression efficiency, and detection performance. 
Benchmark commercial perception payloads and sensing technologies. 
Support integration with onboard AI compute and embedded platforms. 
Prepare technical reports on perception systems and payload integration. 

Skills Required 
Strong understanding of digital electronics and sensor interfaces.
Familiarity with camera systems and perception hardware basics. 
Understanding of video streaming and real-time sensor processing. 
Ability to analyze latency, bandwidth, and perception tradeoffs. 
Familiarity with Linux-based embedded systems and debugging workflows. 
Basic understanding of autonomous sensing and perception systems.

PREFERRED SKILLS 

Exposure to MIPI CSI camera integration and pipeline debugging. 
Familiarity with GStreamer, OpenCV, or multimedia frameworks. 
Exposure to thermal cameras, RADAR, LiDAR, or depth sensors. 
Understanding of optics, focal length, and field-of-view concepts. 
Exposure to embedded AI compute and sensor synchronization methods. 
Familiarity with perception systems and sensor fusion concepts. 

QUALIFICATIONS -M.Tech / M.E/PhD  in relevant discipline
EXPERIENCE REQUIRED -0-2 Years

Candidates must not disclose or share any confidential information related to their job role, projects, company operations, or work responsibilities with any external party. This clause will remain applicable for a lifetime.

Upon joining the company, when you decide to leave the organization in the future, you will not be eligible to join any direct competitor of the company for a period of 3 years post the last working day.
3.Minimum Service Agreement – 2 Years
Candidates from any branch having less than 2 Years of Experience are required to sign a mandatory 2-year Minimum Service Agreement. However, Candidates with more than 2 years of prior experience are exempted from the Minimum Service Agreement. Additionally breach of this agreement will result in a financial penalty of 40% of the CTC.
